$comment: The closed menu of D4 modules. An agent matching a client brief scans this file first, then reads the manifest.json of each module it intends to select. Order here is the deterministic assembly order.

modules.name: d4-site-template
modules.summary: Base Next.js site shell: layout, nav slots, home/about/contact, theme tokens. Always included.

modules.name: d4-cms-core
modules.summary: Admin shell at /admin: password + optional TOTP login, dashboard, JSON data store, image upload. Required by every content module.

modules.name: d4-careers-portal
modules.summary: Careers page with job postings and application forms, managed from the dashboard.

modules.name: d4-insights-blog
modules.summary: Blog or news section written in markdown from the dashboard.

modules.name: d4-catalog
modules.summary: Product or service catalog with categories, specs, and images, managed from the dashboard.

modules.name: d4-gallery-editor
modules.summary: Image galleries managed from the dashboard, with an embeddable Gallery component. Standalone from the catalog.

modules.name: d4-testimonials
modules.summary: Customer testimonials with optional ratings and photos, managed from the dashboard. Embeddable strip plus a /testimonials page.

modules.name: d4-team
modules.summary: Staff profiles with photo, role and biography, reorderable from the dashboard. Embeddable grid plus a /team page.

modules.name: d4-locations
modules.summary: Address, opening hours, keyless map and directions, with LocalBusiness structured data for local search.

modules.name: d4-booking
modules.summary: Appointment booking: services, working hours, generated slots in the business timezone, and a diary in the dashboard. Prevents double booking.

modules.name: d4-events
modules.summary: Events listing with upcoming and past, ticket links and Event structured data.

modules.name: d4-menu
modules.summary: Food and drink menus: courses, dishes, prices and a closed list of dietary markers. Distinct from the catalog.

modules.name: d4-newsletter
modules.summary: Email capture with evidenced consent, self-service unsubscribe and CSV export. Collects the list; does not send.

modules.name: d4-payments
modules.summary: Take payment via Stripe Payment Links. No API keys, no webhooks, no card data on the site. Not a shopping cart.

modules.name: d4-legal
modules.summary: Privacy, terms and cookie pages as editable markdown. Ships unreviewed drafts that 404 until the owner approves them.
